figures.title: This paper in the 13 components, against the field
figures.subtitle: Each box: what this paper does, then common practice across all sensors and how many ledger papers share it.
figures.caption: Verdicts compare the paper's choice for each component with common practice across 8,995 ledger entries on any sensor (silent speech, brain-to-text, lip reading), not only audio-visual papers. Paper counts come from the maintainer's ledger and undercount some components, notably language models, confirmation and correction.

M01.note: Inherited from the WLAS / LRS lineage.

M02.note: Automatic labels as in LRS; slot under-recorded in the ledger.

M03.field: Pretraining and noise augmentation are common
M03.note: Curriculum is inherited from WLAS (near-identical wording); noise augmentation is common practice.

M06.note: No earlier example found in the wiki; a concurrent same-group paper already compared CTC and Transformer, so not ahead.

M07.note: Common practice; the M07 slot itself is under-recorded.

M11.field: In-the-wild sentence test sets; speaker-disjoint only in some
M11.note: Speaker count and train/test speaker overlap not reported; the same group's LRS3 paper says LRS2-BBC likely repeats people.

M12.field: Repeated runs or variance where differences are small
M12.note: 8.2% vs 8.5% is within about 0.34 pt binomial error; no repeats reported.

M13.note: Compute reported (GPU model inconsistent between sections); exact numbers need non-public MV-LRS.
